text:
alex: quick ping — PR #4123 needs approval. CODEOWNERS has /pkg/runtime -> @eng-platform but current owners are on rotation. who can approve this for today's canary?
jess: i'm on PTO today, fyi. can somebody else pick it up?
ben: i'm around but i'm not listed in CODEOWNERS for that dir. i can do an infra/security sanity check though.
sam: i own the public-api stuff, not runtime. i can review later today around 2pm. is this blocking the canary deploy?
alex: yes blocking. small opt-in flag change + tests. deploy logs show one flaky e2e failing unrelated to change.
deploy-bot: auto-merge blocked — required approvals missing (CODEOWNERS: /pkg/runtime). CI: e2e failed (flake suspected).
tina: i can rubber-stamp if tests are green. @jess do you want to delegate approval to me for the rotation window?
jess: @tina yes please, delegate to tina for this week. leave a comment explaining the delegation. :+1:
sam: quick heads-up — change touches KV cache path, watch perf test in CI, might need a quick perf run.
alex: i'll run local perf and post numbers. if perf looks fine and e2e is flaky, can someone merge after rerun?
ben: we shouldn't bypass required CI. if it's a flake, we'll re-run the job (I can trigger). can't approve merge with failing required checks.
alex: understood — re-running now and will push a retry.
(tiny pause)
alex: retriggered CI. updated PR with note: "rerun due to unrelated e2e flake" and added perf numbers.
tina: left an approval review and a short comment about KV perf caveat. approved ✅
alex: thanks! created INF-789 (jira) to follow up on CODEOWNERS rotation docs + fallback approver list.
jess: thanks everyone — when you have a sec can we add a fallback alias like @eng-runtime-admins in CODEOWNERS so a small on-call group can approve during rotations?
sam: +1 to alias. also maybe include a short delegation process in the README (how to delegate approvals).
alex: noted, i'll file a follow-up PR to add alias and delegation steps.
ben: once CI passes i'll rerun the jobs if needed and someone with approval can merge.
alex: final status — CI green, tina approved, canary window still open. anyone merge?
tina: merging now. will watch the canary rollout. :eyes:
ben: thanks — i'll keep an eye on infra metrics.
alex: appreciate it, team.
